layouts.name: Nutts Corner
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Historical Dundrod Road main course with the northern dip chicane, inward western notch, eastern straight and short southern return. The independently mapped 2018 raceway branches form an exact closed node-connected circuit; the allowed shared timing point is 0.6 m from this route. The eastern inner hairpin, full southern extension and the longer southwestern alternate loop are excluded because they change the listed course identity. A small access spur is not included in the closed racing lap. The source measures 840.9 m, 98.1 m shorter than the catalogue scalar of 939 m; this unresolved distance difference is retained and no coordinates or extra branches are added to force agreement. The primary experience operator identifies the seven-corner car layout at this venue; the archive layout facts support the historical branch choice, not coordinates. This is a historical draft centerline, not a validated 939 m timing lap. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 840.9 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
